items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Al Dickerson says -- he leaned over on the piano, he says, like this, 'What are you going to play, man?' And so, I obliged him.

ctx.x: I didn't know this was going on. So Al Dickerson says -- he leaned over on the piano, he says, like this, "What are you going to play, man?" And so, I obliged him. I was full of accommodations that day, and I said, "The Peanut Vendor", man."
